# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

 

## Tricia Fitzgerald's Story

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.

### Meet The Heroes Behind Patient Safety

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]

### Four Colleagues, Four Scientific Journeys: Voices of Women in Science

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]

Cardiopulmonary.

reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

### Information You Can Trust

Chemocare.com is a comprehensive resource for cancer patients and their caregivers that provides
chemotherapy drug and side effect information, cancer wellness information, and links to additional
reliable resources and organizations.

All information provided on this website is created and reviewed by a multidisciplinary team at
Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

### [Drug Information][42]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

## [Nutrition During Chemotherapy][48]

Practicing healthy eating habits throughout cancer treatment is essential. Staying hydrated and
maintaining muscle tissue with enough fluids, calories and nutrients can reduce treatment delays,
boost your immune system and help minimize debilitating side effects such as fatigue.

Navigating reliable, useful information can be overwhelming. We want to help you and your caregivers
with suggestions for maintaining a healthy diet during chemotherapy.

### Information You Can Trust

Chemocare.com is a comprehensive resource for cancer patients and their caregivers that provides
chemotherapy drug and side effect information, cancer wellness information, and links to additional
reliable resources and organizations.

All information provided on this website is created and reviewed by a multidisciplinary team at
Cleveland Clinic or is referenced from reliable medical and community resources.

### About

While undergoing cancer treatment at Cleveland Clinic, Scott Hamilton, an Olympic gold medalist in
figure skating, discovered that it was difficult to find a reliable online resource where
information about chemotherapy was presented in a clear, easy to understand and easy to locate
format. As a result, his idea to create a patient friendly website was born. Chemocare.com went
online in December 2002 to provide cancer patients and their caregivers with clear and accurate
information about chemotherapy, and to empower them to become active participants in their
treatment. Several updates to the site since 2002 include translating the website into Spanish,
becoming mobile friendly, educational videos, as well as continuing to add and update all FDA
approved drugs for the treatment of cancer.

### [Drug Information][42]

Find the latest information about chemotherapy drugs including how they work, their potential side
effects, and self care tips while on these therapies.

## [Nutrition During Chemotherapy][48]

Practicing healthy eating habits throughout cancer treatment is essential. Staying hydrated and
maintaining muscle tissue with enough fluids, calories and nutrients can reduce treatment delays,
boost your immune system and help minimize debilitating side effects such as fatigue.

Navigating reliable, useful information can be overwhelming. We want to help you and your caregivers
with suggestions for maintaining a healthy diet during chemotherapy.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

[ ParHealth.com ][7]

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

[Search Medicines][22] [about us][23]
* ISO 9001:2015 Certified · WHO-GSDP Compliant Pharmaceutical Supplier

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Together we're better

Inspire is the world's largest health community.

**Find the support you need**
in a space built for you

# Built for connection, not clicks

Inspire brings together patients and caregivers who know what it’s like to live with a health
condition. It’s a place to share experiences, ask questions, and find real connection with people
who understand. Here, personal stories meet trusted information to help you feel more informed and
confident. You can engage on your own terms—openly or anonymously—in a space built for honest,
judgment-free conversation. Every voice helps someone else feel less alone, and together, members
create a community that drives awareness, understanding, and change.
Join now for free
[image]

# Stay connected wherever you are

The Inspire app makes it easy to keep up with your communities, share updates, and find support when
you need it most. Available on both iOS and Android

[image]

# Communities for every health journey

Explore hundreds of patient and caregiver communities. They cover everything from rare and chronic
conditions to genetic, oncology, autoimmune, mental health, and everything in between. Each
community is shaped by real people sharing lived experiences, and offering encouragement.
* [Advanced Breast Cancer][8]
* [Lung Cancer][9]
* [Crohn's Disease & Ulcerative Colitis][10]
* [Ovarian Cancer][11]
* [Lupus][12]
* [Scleroderma Foundation][13]
* [Psoriasis][14]
* [Rare & Genetic Disorders][15]
* [Autoimmune Disease][16]
* [Bone Health & Osteoporosis][17]
Search our communities
[image]

# Partnering to strengthen every patient community

Inspire collaborates with leading advocacy organizations to extend their reach and bring trusted
resources directly to our shared members. Together, we create spaces that amplify patient voices,
foster connection, and drive meaningful change.
Become a partner

# Accelerate life-changing discoveries

Inspire is vital to those striving to develop better treatments, improve care, and deliver stronger
outcomes for patients. By engaging millions of patients and caregivers across thousands of health
conditions, Inspire helps sponsors better understand real-world experiences, raise awareness, and
accelerate the path from discovery to delivery.
Work with us

# Together we're better

Inspire is the world's largest health community.

**Find the support you need**
in a space built for you

# Built for connection, not clicks

Inspire brings together patients and caregivers who know what it’s like to live with a health
condition. It’s a place to share experiences, ask questions, and find real connection with people
who understand. Here, personal stories meet trusted information to help you feel more informed and
confident. You can engage on your own terms—openly or anonymously—in a space built for honest,
judgment-free conversation. Every voice helps someone else feel less alone, and together, members
create a community that drives awareness, understanding, and change.
Join now for free
[image]

# Stay connected wherever you are

The Inspire app makes it easy to keep up with your communities, share updates, and find support when
you need it most. Available on both iOS and Android

[image]

# Communities for every health journey

Explore hundreds of patient and caregiver communities. They cover everything from rare and chronic
conditions to genetic, oncology, autoimmune, mental health, and everything in between. Each
community is shaped by real people sharing lived experiences, and offering encouragement.
* [Advanced Breast Cancer][8]
* [Lung Cancer][9]
* [Crohn's Disease & Ulcerative Colitis][10]
* [Ovarian Cancer][11]
* [Lupus][12]
* [Scleroderma Foundation][13]
* [Psoriasis][14]
* [Rare & Genetic Disorders][15]
* [Autoimmune Disease][16]
* [Bone Health & Osteoporosis][17]
Search our communities
[image]

# Partnering to strengthen every patient community

Inspire collaborates with leading advocacy organizations to extend their reach and bring trusted
resources directly to our shared members. Together, we create spaces that amplify patient voices,
foster connection, and drive meaningful change.
Become a partner

# Accelerate life-changing discoveries

Inspire is vital to those striving to develop better treatments, improve care, and deliver stronger
outcomes for patients. By engaging millions of patients and caregivers across thousands of health
conditions, Inspire helps sponsors better understand real-world experiences, raise awareness, and
accelerate the path from discovery to delivery.
Work with us

## The Lupin Story

Driven by Science,
Inspired by Patients

Founded by Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta in 1968,
Lupin aimed to improve access to essential
medicines. Today we stand tall as a globally
trusted pharmaceutical company guided by
science, quality, and a patient-first mindset.

[
Know More
][105]

We Catalyze
Treatments
That Transform
Hope Into
Healing

Ours is a purpose-driven
journey of over 5 decades,
where we aim to improve
lives, build sustainability
and deliver long-term
solutions to all.

Relief from disease

Delivering meaningful
treatments for today and
tomorrow

Innovation to unlock access at scale

Making complex, cutting-edge
healthcare solutions accessible
to all

Driven by Science,
Inspired by Patients

Founded by Dr. Desh Bandhu Gupta in 1968,
Lupin aimed to improve access to essential
medicines. Today we stand tall as a globally
trusted pharmaceutical company guided by
science, quality, and a patient-first mindset.

[
Know More

We Catalyze
Treatments
That Transform
Hope Into
Healing

Ours is a purpose-driven
journey of over 5 decades,
where we aim to improve
lives, build sustainability
and deliver long-term
solutions to all.

Relief from disease

Delivering meaningful
treatments for today and
tomorrow

Innovation to unlock access at scale

Making complex, cutting-edge
healthcare solutions accessible
to all

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

## Verification Program

#### The PharmacyChecker Verification team accredits international online pharmacies that meet high
#### standards of pharmacy practice by evaluating them in the [PharmacyChecker International
#### Pharmacy Verification Program][54]. To verify that they meet PharmacyChecker standards,
#### pharmacies must prove adherence to the laws in the countries where they operate in addition to
#### PharmacyChecker policies.

[ [Example PharmacyChecker seal] ][55]
* Prescription orders dispensed by licensed pharmacies
* Requires a Prescription
* International sales of controlled drugs to the U.S. prohibited
* Meets website security requirements
* Publishes customer privacy policy on website
* Publishes contact information on website for customer service
* Pharmacist consultation offered to customers
* Quantities marketed on website restricted to a maximum of 3 months' supply at a time
* Disclosure of pharmacy location to consumer prior to purchase
* Marketing claims are truthful and not misleading
[Find Accredited Pharmacies][56]

PharmacyChecker.com supports the missions of several non-profit organizations to help Americans and
global consumers afford prescription medication, and we encourage you to participate in the advocacy
campaigns of [Prescription Justice][57] and other organizations advocating for access to lower drug
prices.

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in

been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by

the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The $4B Patent Cliff: Navigating the Generic Surge as Astellas’ Xtandi Nears Expiration

22 January 2026
Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to
capturing market share in a post-Xtandi era.

[[2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report]][16]

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[Read →][18]
[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[Read →][21]
[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

our generics business.

Wait. What does that mean?
It means that we deliver generics and biosimilars at scale and we're focused on developing new
medicines in areas of greatest unmet need.

Like neuroscience and immunology. It means stepping up innovation, working with partners and experts
to do whatever it takes. New medicines. Reaching more patients. Faster.

Wait. What does that look like?

It looks like developments in severe mental illness. Progress for movement disorders. Leading brands
in migraine. And it looks like revolutionizing therapies for autoimmune diseases. A promising
pipeline poised to bring treatments to millions of patients and caregivers.

progress is undeniable. And we're motivated by the people who depend on it. We’re all in for better
health.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What are medical grade skincare systems?

Medical grade skincare systems are coordinated routines built around high-performance active
ingredients to target specific skin concerns. Truth Treatments combines pharmacist-formulated
products into simple protocols designed to support healthier-looking skin without fillers or
unnecessary ingredients.

How is Truth Treatments different from over-the-counter skincare?

Truth Treatments uses 100% active and functional ingredients, lipid-based delivery, and
pharmacist-formulated skincare systems. Instead of water-heavy formulas with fillers and fragrance,
every ingredient is chosen to support skin health and visible results.

Why does Truth Treatments use THDA Vitamin C?

Truth Treatments uses THDA because it is a stable, lipid-soluble form of vitamin C designed to work
with the skin's natural barrier. It helps support brighter, firmer, healthier-looking skin while
being gentler than many traditional vitamin C formulas.

What order should I use Truth Treatments products?

Follow a simple routine: cleanse, prep, treat, moisturize, and apply sunscreen during the day. Using
Truth Treatments products in the recommended order helps maximize the performance of your skincare
system.

How long does it take to see results?

Many people notice improved hydration and radiance within a few weeks. More significant improvements
in skin tone, texture, and firmness typically develop with consistent daily use over time.

Are Truth Treatments skincare systems good for sensitive skin?

Yes. Truth Treatments offers skincare systems for sensitive, dry, and compromised skin, including
barrier-support formulas like Omega 6 Healing Cream. Start slowly and follow the recommended routine
for your skin type.
